n, m, M = map(int, input().split())

maxn = 512
c = [[0] * maxn for _ in range(maxn)]
p = [[0] * maxn for _ in range(maxn)]

# Precompute binomial coefficients c[i][j]
for i in range(maxn):
    for j in range(i + 1):
        c[i][j] = 1 if j == 0 else (c[i - 1][j] + c[i - 1][j - 1]) % M

# Precompute powers p[i][j]
for i in range(maxn):
    p[i][0] = 1
    for j in range(1, maxn):
        p[i][j] = (p[i][j - 1] * i) % M

def g(a, b):
    if b == 0:
        return 1
    return (p[a + 1][b - 1] * p[2][b] % M) * ((a + 1 - b) % M) % M

you = 0
for i in range(2, m + 1):
    for d in range(1, i):
        me = (d * (d + 1) // 2) % M
        me = (me * c[i - 1][d]) % M
        me = (me * p[d + 1][d - 1]) % M
        me = (me * g(n - d - 1, i - d)) % M
        me = (me * p[2][d]) % M
        me = (me * p[n + 1 - (d + 1)][m - i]) % M
        me = (me * p[2][m - i]) % M
        you = (you + 2 * me) % M

result = (you * (n + 1 - m)) % M
print(result)
